```{r}
set.seed(42)

tmp <- subset(t.cells, celltype.malig == "T_Cells")
tmp <- R2easyviz::r2sample_seurat(tmp, group_var = "orig.merge", n = 5000, barcode_column = "barcode.unique")

LayerData(tmp, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") <- as(LayerData(tmp, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"), "dgCMatrix")
tmp <- NormalizeData(tmp)

tmp <- FindVariableFeatures(tmp, nfeatures = 2000)
tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                VariableFeatures(tmp), value = TRUE)
VariableFeatures(tmp) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(tmp), tcr_bcr)
tmp <- ScaleData(tmp)
tmp <- RunPCA(tmp, npcs = 30)
tmp <- RunHarmony(tmp, group.by.vars = "orig.merge", reduction = "pca", reduction.save = "harmony")
tmp <- RunUMAP(tmp, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:15)

DimPlot(tmp, group.by = "orig.merge", shuffle = T)+NoLegend()

tmp <- FindNeighbors(tmp, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:15)
tmp <- FindClusters(tmp, resolution = c(0.1,0.5,1))
```

```{r cd4_strict_filter}
excl_markers <- c("CD8A", "CD8B", "TRDC", "FOXP3", "NCAM1", "KLRD1")
excl_present <- intersect(excl_markers, rownames(cd4))
expr_excl    <- FetchData(cd4, vars = excl_present, layer = "data")
exclude      <- rowSums(expr_excl > 0) > 0

cd4.ss <- cd4[, !exclude]

ncol(cd4)

cd4.keep <- cd4.ss$barcode.unique
```

```{r pca_qc}
se <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")
meta_se <- as.data.frame(colData(se))

dge_qc  <- DGEList(counts = assay(se, "counts"))
dge_qc  <- calcNormFactors(dge_qc)
logcpm  <- edgeR::cpm(dge_qc, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

E_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(logcpm, batch = meta_se$GEO.Cohort,
                                  design = model.matrix(~ celltype.malig + Tissue, data = meta_se))

pca_res <- prcomp(t(E_bc), scale. = FALSE)
pct_var <- round(100 * pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2), 1)

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(GEO.Cohort     = meta_se$GEO.Cohort,
         Tissue         = meta_se$Tissue,
         celltype.malig = meta_se$celltype.malig,
         Sample.Type    = meta_se$Sample.Type.simple)

plot_pca <- function(df, color_var, label) {
  ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
    geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)"),
         color = label, title = label) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
          aspect.ratio = 1)
}

# canonical colors used across the analysis
tissue_cols <- c("blood" = "#E15759", "lymph node" = "#59A14F", "skin" = "#4E79A7")
malig_cols  <- c("CTCL" = "#F8766D", "T_Cells" = "#00BFC4")

p1 <- plot_pca(pca_df, "GEO.Cohort",    "Cohort")      + guides(color = "none")
p2 <- plot_pca(pca_df, "Tissue",         "Tissue")     + scale_color_manual(values = tissue_cols)
p3 <- plot_pca(pca_df, "celltype.malig", "Malignancy") + scale_color_manual(values = malig_cols)
p4 <- plot_pca(pca_df, "Sample.Type",    "Lesion Type")

p_combined <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p_combined

#ggsave("figs/pca_qc.pdf", p_combined, width = 10, height = 8)

p_combined.ss <- p2 / p3 +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p_combined.ss

ggsave("figs/pca_qc.ss.pdf", p_combined.ss, width = 6, height = 8)
```

```{r dream}
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
meta$celltype.malig <- factor(meta$celltype.malig, levels = c("T_Cells", "CTCL"))

dge <- DGEList(counts = assay(se, "counts"))
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                rownames(dge), value = TRUE)
dge <- dge[!rownames(dge) %in% tcr_bcr, ]

keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = meta$celltype.malig, min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5, min.prop = 0.1)
dge  <- dge[keep, ]
message(sprintf("Genes retained after filtering: %d", sum(keep)))

form <- ~ celltype.malig + Tissue + (1|Patient.ID) + (1|GEO.Cohort)
vobj <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))

form_vp <- ~ (1|celltype.malig) + (1|Tissue) + (1|Patient.ID) + (1|GEO.Cohort) + (1|Sample.Type.simple)
varPart  <- fitExtractVarPartModel(vobj, form_vp, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))

varPart <- read.csv("results/varPart.csv", row.names = 1)
plotVarPart(sortCols(varPart)) + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) + coord_flip()
ggsave("figs/varplot.pdf", height = 6, width = 4)

write.csv(varPart, "results/varPart.csv")
```

```{r fit}
fit  <- dream(vobj, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
fit  <- eBayes(fit)

res_df <- topTable(fit, coef = "celltype.maligCTCL", number = Inf) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val)

saveRDS(res_df, "results/res_df_cd4.rds")
write.csv(res_df, "results/res_df_cd4.csv")
```

```{r volcano, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
res_df <- readRDS("results/res_df_cd4.rds")
lfc_limit <- quantile(abs(res_df$logFC), 0.99)

label_genes <- bind_rows(
  res_df %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% slice_head(n = 10),
  res_df %>% arrange(t)       %>% slice_head(n = 10)
)

p_volc <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val), color = logFC)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data          = label_genes,
    aes(label     = gene),
    size          = 3.5,
    color         = "black",
    max.overlaps  = 20,
    segment.size  = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    box.padding   = 0.3,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "grey80",
    high     = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-lfc_limit, lfc_limit),
    oob      = scales::squish,
    name     = "log2FC"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "log2FC", y = "-log10(padj)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p_volc
ggsave("figs/volcano_dream.pdf", p_volc, width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r boxplots}
res_df <- readRDS("results/res_df_cd4.rds")
top_genes_box <- c(

top_genes_box <- c("MFSD10", "SUN1", "TOX", "GZMK", "AIF1", "CD7")
box_df <- as.data.frame(t(vobj$E[top_genes_box, ])) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>%
  mutate(celltype = meta$celltype.malig[match(sample, rownames(meta))],
         gene = factor(gene, levels = top_genes_box))

  ggplot(box_df[box_df$gene == g, ], aes(x = celltype, y = expr, fill = celltype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("T_Cells" = "#00BFC4", "CTCL" = "#F8766D")) +
    labs(title = g, x = NULL, y = "log-CPM") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})

p_boxes <- wrap_plots(box_plots, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
p_boxes
ggsave("figs/boxplots_top_deg.pdf", p_boxes, width = 9, height = 6)
```

```{r boxplots_dream_adjusted}
# dream-corrected log-CPM: strip the nuisance terms the DEG model conditions on
# (Tissue fixed effect + Patient.ID/GEO.Cohort random effects) while keeping the
# malignancy effect + intercept, so within-group scatter is residual only and the
# T_Cells-vs-CTCL separation matches the estimated logFC/t. residuals(fit, vobj)
# already removes the fixed nuisance terms AND the random-effect BLUPs; we then add
# back just the intercept + celltype.maligCTCL contribution.
keep_cols <- c("(Intercept)", "celltype.maligCTCL")
kept_fit  <- fit$coefficients[top_genes_box, keep_cols] %*% t(fit$design[, keep_cols])
adj_E     <- residuals(fit, vobj)[top_genes_box, ] + kept_fit   # genes x samples

box_df_adj <- as.data.frame(t(adj_E)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>%
  mutate(celltype = meta$celltype.malig[match(sample, rownames(meta))],
         gene = factor(gene, levels = top_genes_box))

box_plots_adj <- lapply(top_genes_box, function(g) {
  ggplot(box_df_adj[box_df_adj$gene == g, ], aes(x = celltype, y = expr, fill = celltype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("T_Cells" = "#00BFC4", "CTCL" = "#F8766D")) +
    labs(title = g, x = NULL, y = "adj. log-CPM (dream)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})

p_boxes_adj <- wrap_plots(box_plots_adj, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
p_boxes_adj
ggsave("figs/boxplots_top_deg_dream_adjusted.pdf", p_boxes_adj, width = 9, height = 6)
```

```{r gsea}
# Hallmark gene sets. NES > 0 = enriched in CTCL (coef celltype.maligCTCL).
pathway_list <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)

# one value per gene (most extreme on dupes), drop NAs, then sort
ranks <- res_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(t), !is.na(gene)) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(t = t[which.max(abs(t))], .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

# eps = 0 for exact small p-values so padj/dot-size ordering is meaningful
set.seed(42)
gsea_res <- fgsea(pathways = pathway_list, stats = ranks,
                  minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, eps = 0, nproc = 16) %>%
  mutate(
    sig           = padj < 0.05,
    pathway_label = gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway),
    pathway_label = gsub("_", " ", pathway_label),
    pathway_label = stringr::str_wrap(pathway_label, width = 20)
  )

# top 10 up + top 10 down among significant pathways
top_paths <- gsea_res %>% dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(NES, n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(gsea_res %>% dplyr::filter(sig) %>% dplyr::slice_min(NES, n = 10))

nes_lim <- quantile(abs(gsea_res$NES), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

p_gsea <- top_paths %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(NES)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NES, y = reorder(pathway_label, NES),
             size = -log10(padj), color = NES)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "grey80",
    high     = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-nes_lim, nes_lim),
    oob      = scales::squish,
    name     = "NES"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), name = "-log10(FDR)") +
  labs(x = "NES  (→ enriched in CTCL)", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, lineheight = 0.8))

p_gsea
ggsave("figs/gsea_dotplot.pdf", p_gsea, width = 6.5, height = 6)

saveRDS(gsea_res, "results/gsea_res_cd4.rds")
```

```{r functional_enrichment}
library(decoupleR)

stat_mat <- matrix(
  res_df$t,
  ncol     = 1,
  dimnames = list(res_df$gene, "CTCL_vs_T_Cells")
)

# PROGENy: 14 cancer-relevant signaling pathways
progeny_net <- get_progeny(organism = "human", top = 500)

progeny_res <- run_wmean(
  mat     = stat_mat,
  net     = progeny_net,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "weight",
  times   = 1000,
  minsize = 5
) %>%
  filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") %>%
  arrange(score)

p_progeny <- ggplot(progeny_res, aes(x = score, y = reorder(source, score), fill = score)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "grey80",
    high     = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    name     = "Activity"
  ) +
  labs(x = "PROGENy score", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, lineheight = 0.8))

p_progeny
ggsave("figs/progeny_pathways.pdf", p_progeny, width = 6, height = 5.5)

# TF activity with CollecTRI
collectri_net <- get_collectri(organism = "human", split_complexes = FALSE)

tf_res <- run_ulm(
  mat     = stat_mat,
  net     = collectri_net,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "mor",
  minsize = 5
) %>%
  filter(statistic == "ulm") %>%
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
         sig = p_value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(score)

tf_top <- bind_rows(
  tf_res %>% filter(sig) %>% slice_max(score, n = 5),
  tf_res %>% filter(sig) %>% slice_min(score, n = 5)
) %>%
  distinct(source, .keep_all = TRUE)

score_lim <- quantile(abs(tf_top$score), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

p_tf <- ggplot(tf_top, aes(x = score, y = reorder(source, score),
                            size = -log10(fdr), color = score)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low      = "steelblue",
    mid      = "grey80",
    high     = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-score_lim, score_lim),
    oob      = scales::squish,
    name     = "Activity"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), name = "-log10(FDR)") +
  labs(x = "TF activity score", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, lineheight = 0.8))

p_tf
ggsave("figs/tf_activity.pdf", p_tf, width = 6, height = 5.5)

saveRDS(list(progeny = progeny_res, tf = tf_res), "results/functional_enrichment.rds")
```

```{r pca_ctcl}
se_all   <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")
se_malig <- se_all[, colData(se_all)$celltype.malig == "CTCL"]
meta_malig <- as.data.frame(colData(se_malig))

dge_malig  <- DGEList(counts = assay(se_malig, "counts"))
dge_malig  <- calcNormFactors(dge_malig)
logcpm_malig <- edgeR::cpm(dge_malig, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

E_bc_malig <- limma::removeBatchEffect(logcpm_malig, batch = meta_malig$GEO.Cohort,
                                        design = model.matrix(~ Tissue, data = meta_malig))

pca_malig   <- prcomp(t(E_bc_malig), scale. = FALSE)
pct_malig   <- round(100 * pca_malig$sdev^2 / sum(pca_malig$sdev^2), 1)

pca_malig_df <- as.data.frame(pca_malig$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  mutate(GEO.Cohort  = meta_malig$GEO.Cohort,
         Tissue      = meta_malig$Tissue,
         celltype.malig = meta_malig$celltype.malig,
         Sample.Type = meta_malig$Sample.Type.simple)

plot_pca_malig <- function(df, color_var, show_axis = FALSE) {
  ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
    geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      x     = if (show_axis) paste0("PC1 (", pct_malig[1], "%)") else NULL,
      y     = if (show_axis) paste0("PC2 (", pct_malig[2], "%)") else NULL,
      color = color_var,
      title = color_var
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text  = if (!show_axis) element_blank() else element_text(),
      axis.ticks = if (!show_axis) element_blank() else element_line()
    )
}

m1 <- plot_pca_malig(pca_malig_df, "GEO.Cohort")  + NoLegend()
m2 <- plot_pca_malig(pca_malig_df, "Tissue")       + scale_color_manual(values = tissue_cols) + NoLegend()
m3 <- plot_pca_malig(pca_malig_df, "celltype.malig", show_axis = TRUE) + scale_color_manual(values = malig_cols) + NoLegend()
m4 <- plot_pca_malig(pca_malig_df, "Sample.Type")  + NoLegend()

m_combined <- (m1 | m2) / (m3 | m4)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- TEST: MF-only and SS-only CD4 CTCL vs normal CD4 T cells     -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Reuses the CD4-filtered pseudobulk `se` (blood/skin, non-CD8/GDT clone) -->
<!-- from the pseudobulk_filter chunk, plus `obj` from above. `se` carries    -->
<!-- only Dx.simple (BID/CTCL/HC), so map the finer Dx (MF/SS) on by sample.  -->

```{r cd4_subtype_setup}
# read in the objects these chunks depend on
obj <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
se  <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")

# reproduce the CD4-filtered pseudobulk (same as the pseudobulk_filter chunk)
se <- se[, colData(se)$Tissue %in% c("blood", "skin") &
            !colData(se)$malig.pheno %in% c("GDT", "CD8")]

# per-sample MF/SS label (se only carries Dx.simple), mapped from obj
dx_map <- obj@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, Dx)
colData(se)$Dx <- dx_map$Dx[match(colData(se)$orig.merge, dx_map$orig.merge)]

# same dream pipeline as the CD4 `dream` + `fit` chunks, run on a Dx subset
run_cd4_subtype_dream <- function(se_sub) {
  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(se_sub))
  meta$celltype.malig <- factor(meta$celltype.malig, levels = c("T_Cells", "CTCL"))

  dge <- DGEList(counts = assay(se_sub, "counts"))
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                  rownames(dge), value = TRUE)
  dge <- dge[!rownames(dge) %in% tcr_bcr, ]

  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = meta$celltype.malig,
                       min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5, min.prop = 0.1)
  dge  <- dge[keep, ]
  message(sprintf("Genes retained after filtering: %d", sum(keep)))

  form <- ~ celltype.malig + Tissue + (1|Patient.ID) + (1|GEO.Cohort)
  vobj <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit  <- dream(vobj, form, meta, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
  fit  <- eBayes(fit)

  topTable(fit, coef = "celltype.maligCTCL", number = Inf) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val)
}

volcano_subtype <- function(res, title) {
  lfc_lim <- quantile(abs(res$logFC), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = logFC)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey80", high = "firebrick",
                          midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lfc_lim, lfc_lim),
                          oob = scales::squish, name = "log2FC") +
    labs(x = "log2FC (CTCL vs normal CD4 T)", y = "-log10(P)", title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
}
```

```{r cd4_mf_deg, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
se_mf <- se[, colData(se)$Dx %in% "MF"]
print(table(colData(se_mf)$celltype.malig, colData(se_mf)$Tissue))

res_mf <- run_cd4_subtype_dream(se_mf)
message(sprintf("MF significant DEGs (FDR < 0.05): %d", sum(res_mf$sig)))
head(res_mf, 30)
volcano_subtype(res_mf, "MF: CTCL vs normal CD4 T")
```

```{r cd4_mf_ss_tstat_scatter, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5}
# merge the moderated t statistics from each subtype on shared genes
t_merge <- inner_join(
  res_mf %>% select(gene, t_MF = t),
  res_ss %>% select(gene, t_SS = t),
  by = "gene"
) %>%
  mutate(dif = t_MF - t_SS) %>%
  mutate(sum = t_MF + t_SS)

cor_val <- cor(t_merge$t_MF, t_merge$t_SS)

lfc_lim <- quantile(abs(t_merge$dif), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(t_merge, aes(x = t_SS, y = t_MF)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = dif), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey80", high = "firebrick",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lfc_lim, lfc_lim),
                        oob = scales::squish, name = "MF - SS t") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor_val), size = 4.5) +
  labs(x = "SS t statistic", y = "MF t statistic",
       title = "CTCL vs normal CD4 T: MF vs SS") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- TEST: MF Tumor vs MF Patch/Plaque (within CTCL cells)       -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Clean within-MF progression axis: restrict to MF patients only so the   -->
<!-- lesion contrast isn't confounded by SS/erythroderma. Both are skin, so   -->
<!-- no Tissue term. Dx (MF) mapped from obj since se carries only Dx.simple. -->

```{r mf_lesion_setup}
obj    <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
se_all <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")

dx_map <- obj@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, Dx)
colData(se_all)$Dx <- dx_map$Dx[match(colData(se_all)$orig.merge, dx_map$orig.merge)]

se_mfl <- se_all[, colData(se_all)$celltype.malig == "CTCL" &
                    colData(se_all)$Dx == "MF" &
                    colData(se_all)$Sample.Type.simple %in% c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor")]

meta_mfl <- as.data.frame(colData(se_mfl))
meta_mfl$lesion <- factor(meta_mfl$Sample.Type.simple, levels = c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor"))
print(table(meta_mfl$lesion))          # both skin -> no Tissue term

dge_mfl <- DGEList(counts = assay(se_mfl, "counts"))
dge_mfl <- calcNormFactors(dge_mfl)
tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                rownames(dge_mfl), value = TRUE)
dge_mfl <- dge_mfl[!rownames(dge_mfl) %in% tcr_bcr, ]

keep <- filterByExpr(dge_mfl, group = meta_mfl$lesion,
                     min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5, min.prop = 0.1)
dge_mfl <- dge_mfl[keep, ]
message(sprintf("Genes retained after filtering: %d", sum(keep)))

form_mfl <- ~ lesion + (1|Patient.ID) + (1|GEO.Cohort)
vobj_mfl <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge_mfl, form_mfl, meta_mfl, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
fit_mfl  <- dream(vobj_mfl, form_mfl, meta_mfl, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
fit_mfl  <- eBayes(fit_mfl)
```

```{r mf_lesion_results, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
# coef lesionTumor: positive logFC = up in MF tumor vs MF patch/plaque

  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%

                        oob = scales::squish, name = "log2FC") +
  labs(x = "log2FC (MF Tumor vs MF Patch/Plaque)", y = "-log10(P)",
       title = "MF: Tumor vs Patch/Plaque") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```


<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- TEST: stage-dependent malignancy (interaction / diff-in-diff) -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Instead of comparing malignant cells directly across stage (confounded, -->
<!-- underpowered), ask how the WITHIN-SAMPLE CTCL-vs-benign-CD4 signature    -->
<!-- differs between MF Tumor and MF Patch/Plaque. Each malignant arm is      -->
<!-- anchored to its own local normal reference, cancelling sample/tissue/    -->
<!-- cohort background that hits both compartments equally. The interaction   -->
<!-- coef is the stage-dependent, background-subtracted malignancy program.   -->

```{r mf_interaction_setup}
obj    <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
se_all <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")

dx_map <- obj@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, Dx)
colData(se_all)$Dx <- dx_map$Dx[match(colData(se_all)$orig.merge, dx_map$orig.merge)]

se_int <- se_all[, colData(se_all)$Dx == "MF" &
                    !colData(se_all)$malig.pheno %in% c("GDT", "CD8") &
                    colData(se_all)$Sample.Type.simple %in% c("Patch_Plaque", "Tumor")]

meta_int <- as.data.frame(colData(se_int))
# cell-means grouping: {norm,mal} x {PP,Tum} -> 4 groups
meta_int$arm   <- ifelse(meta_int$celltype.malig == "CTCL", "mal", "norm")
meta_int$les   <- ifelse(meta_int$Sample.Type.simple == "Tumor", "Tum", "PP")
meta_int$group <- factor(paste0(meta_int$arm, meta_int$les),
                         levels = c("normPP", "malPP", "normTum", "malTum"))
print(table(meta_int$group))

dge_int <- DGEList(counts = assay(se_int, "counts"))
dge_int <- calcNormFactors(dge_int)
tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                rownames(dge_int), value = TRUE)
dge_int <- dge_int[!rownames(dge_int) %in% tcr_bcr, ]

keep <- filterByExpr(dge_int, group = meta_int$group,
                     min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5, min.prop = 0.1)
dge_int <- dge_int[keep, ]
message(sprintf("Genes retained after filtering: %d", sum(keep)))

# all skin -> no Tissue term
form_int <- ~ 0 + group + (1|Patient.ID) + (1|GEO.Cohort)
vobj_int <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge_int, form_int, meta_int, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))

L_int <- makeContrastsDream(form_int, meta_int, contrasts = c(
  CTCLvsNorm_PP  = "groupmalPP  - groupnormPP",
  CTCLvsNorm_Tum = "groupmalTum - groupnormTum",
  Interaction    = "(groupmalTum - groupnormTum) - (groupmalPP - groupnormPP)"))

fit_int <- dream(vobj_int, form_int, meta_int, L = L_int, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
fit_int <- eBayes(fit_int)
```

```{r mf_interaction_results, fig.height=4, fig.width=5}
get_res <- function(fit, coef) {
  topTable(fit, coef = coef, number = Inf) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val)
}

# stage-dependent malignancy signature: how CTCL-vs-normal differs Tumor vs PP
res_int <- get_res(fit_int, "Interaction")
message(sprintf("Stage-dependent malignancy DEGs (interaction, FDR < 0.05): %d",
                sum(res_int$sig)))
head(res_int, 30)

lfc_lim <- quantile(abs(res_int$logFC), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
ggplot(res_int, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), color = logFC)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey80", high = "firebrick",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lfc_lim, lfc_lim),
                        oob = scales::squish, name = "interaction\nlog2FC") +
  labs(x = "interaction log2FC  [(CTCL-norm)|Tum - (CTCL-norm)|PP]", y = "-log10(P)",
       title = "MF: stage-dependent malignancy program") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

```{r mf_interaction_scatter, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5}
# within-lesion CTCL-vs-normal signatures, on shared genes
res_pp  <- get_res(fit_int, "CTCLvsNorm_PP")
res_tum <- get_res(fit_int, "CTCLvsNorm_Tum")

sig_merge <- inner_join(
  res_pp  %>% select(gene, lfc_PP  = logFC),
  res_tum %>% select(gene, lfc_Tum = logFC),
  by = "gene"
) %>%
  left_join(res_int %>% select(gene, int_lfc = logFC, int_sig = sig), by = "gene")

cor_p <- cor(sig_merge$lfc_PP, sig_merge$lfc_Tum)
cor_s <- cor(sig_merge$lfc_PP, sig_merge$lfc_Tum, method = "spearman")
lim   <- quantile(abs(sig_merge$int_lfc), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(sig_merge, aes(x = lfc_PP, y = lfc_Tum)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(color = int_lfc), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey80", high = "firebrick",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                        oob = scales::squish, name = "interaction\nlog2FC") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
           label = sprintf("r = %.2f  (rho = %.2f)", cor_p, cor_s), size = 4) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "CTCL vs normal CD4  (Patch/Plaque)",
       y = "CTCL vs normal CD4  (Tumor)",
       title = "MF malignancy signature: PP vs Tumor") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```


<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- TEST: CTCL MF vs SS, direct (malignant cells only)          -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Direct malignant-cell contrast, no benign anchor. NOTE: MF/SS is heavily -->
<!-- confounded with Tissue (MF~skin, SS~blood) and cohort, so this conflates -->
<!-- malignant-intrinsic differences with the skin-vs-blood/background axis   -->
<!-- even after adjusting for Tissue + (1|GEO.Cohort). See prose for caveats. -->

```{r ctcl_mf_ss_direct}
obj    <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
se_all <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")

dx_map <- obj@meta.data %>% distinct(orig.merge, Dx)
colData(se_all)$Dx <- dx_map$Dx[match(colData(se_all)$orig.merge, dx_map$orig.merge)]

se_ds <- se_all[, colData(se_all)$celltype.malig == "CTCL" &
                   !colData(se_all)$malig.pheno %in% c("GDT", "CD8") &
                   colData(se_all)$Dx %in% c("MF", "SS") &
                   colData(se_all)$Tissue %in% c("blood", "skin")]

meta_ds <- as.data.frame(colData(se_ds))
meta_ds$Dx <- factor(meta_ds$Dx, levels = c("MF", "SS"))   # coef DxSS = up in SS vs MF
print(table(meta_ds$Dx, meta_ds$Tissue))

dge_ds <- DGEList(counts = assay(se_ds, "counts"))
dge_ds <- calcNormFactors(dge_ds)
tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                rownames(dge_ds), value = TRUE)
dge_ds <- dge_ds[!rownames(dge_ds) %in% tcr_bcr, ]

keep <- filterByExpr(dge_ds, group = meta_ds$Dx,
                     min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5, min.prop = 0.1)
dge_ds <- dge_ds[keep, ]
message(sprintf("Genes retained after filtering: %d", sum(keep)))

# adjust for Tissue (partly absorbs the skin/blood confound) + cohort/patient
form_ds <- ~ Dx + Tissue + (1|Patient.ID) + (1|GEO.Cohort)
vobj_ds <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge_ds, form_ds, meta_ds, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
fit_ds  <- dream(vobj_ds, form_ds, meta_ds, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(16))
fit_ds  <- eBayes(fit_ds)

res_mf_ss_direct <- topTable(fit_ds, coef = "DxSS", number = Inf) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val)

message(sprintf("Direct MF-vs-SS malignant DEGs (FDR < 0.05): %d", sum(res_mf_ss_direct$sig)))
head(res_mf_ss_direct, 30)
```

<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Paired malignant-minus-benign change matrix + robust signed WGCNA -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Fully self-contained: reads only results/bulk.se.rds (+ subtype_df for one -->
<!-- module-trait annotation). For every SAMPLE carrying BOTH a malignant (CTCL) -->
<!-- and a matched benign (T_Cells) CD4 pseudobulk column, form the within-sample -->
<!-- log-CPM change (delta = malignant - benign). Each sample's own benign CD4    -->
<!-- cancels its patient/tissue/cohort background, so the delta matrix is the      -->
<!-- per-sample malignant-reprogramming signal. Robust signed WGCNA (bicor +       -->
<!-- signed network/TOM) then groups genes that co-move in the SAME direction      -->
<!-- across samples into malignancy-change modules.                                -->

```{r cd4_paired_delta_wgcna, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
# --- deps: WGCNA pulls dynamicTreeCut/fastcluster/impute/preprocessCore ---
if (!requireNamespace("WGCNA", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("WGCNA", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
library(WGCNA)
WGCNA::enableWGCNAThreads(nThreads = 16)
# WGCNA masks cor/dplyr verbs; pin the ones we call by name
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select, dplyr::filter, dplyr::count,
                             base::setdiff, .quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(42)

# ---- 1. rebuild the CD4 pseudobulk subset (same filter as pseudobulk_filter) ----
se <- readRDS("results/bulk.se.rds")
se <- se[, colData(se)$Tissue %in% c("blood", "skin") &
            !colData(se)$malig.pheno %in% c("GDT", "CD8")]
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))

# ---- 2. samples with BOTH a malignant (CTCL) and matched benign (T_Cells) column ----
paired_ids <- cd %>%
  dplyr::count(orig.merge, celltype.malig) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = celltype.malig, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::filter(CTCL > 0, T_Cells > 0) %>%
  dplyr::pull(orig.merge)
message(sprintf("paired samples (malignant + matched benign CD4): %d", length(paired_ids)))

se_p <- se[, cd$orig.merge %in% paired_ids]
cd_p <- as.data.frame(colData(se_p))

# ---- 3. normalize on the paired subset, drop TCR/BCR, expression-filter ----
dge <- DGEList(counts = assay(se_p, "counts"))
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                rownames(dge), value = TRUE)
dge <- dge[!rownames(dge) %in% tcr_bcr, ]
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = cd_p$celltype.malig,
                     min.count = 1, min.total.count = 5, min.prop = 0.1)
dge  <- dge[keep, ]
logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
message(sprintf("genes after expression filter: %d", nrow(logcpm)))

# ---- 4. paired delta = malignant - benign per sample (genes x samples) ----
mal_cols <- setNames(paste0(paired_ids, "__CTCL"),    paired_ids)
ben_cols <- setNames(paste0(paired_ids, "__T_Cells"), paired_ids)
stopifnot(all(mal_cols %in% colnames(logcpm)), all(ben_cols %in% colnames(logcpm)))
delta <- logcpm[, mal_cols] - logcpm[, ben_cols]
colnames(delta) <- paired_ids

# keep the most variable change-genes (robust MAD) to focus WGCNA on real co-variation
n_top     <- 6000
mad_delta <- apply(delta, 1, mad)
top_genes <- names(sort(mad_delta, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(n_top, nrow(delta)))]
datExpr   <- t(delta[top_genes, ])          # rows = samples, cols = change-genes
message(sprintf("WGCNA input: %d samples x %d change-genes", nrow(datExpr), ncol(datExpr)))

gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = 0)
if (!gsg$allOK) datExpr <- datExpr[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]

# ---- 5. soft-threshold selection for a SIGNED network ----
powers <- c(1:10, seq(12, 30, 2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers, networkType = "signed",
                         corFnc = "bicor", corOptions = list(use = "p", maxPOutliers = 0.05),
                         RsquaredCut = 0.85, verbose = 0)
# WGCNA signed-network default by sample size (FAQ table). The paired-delta
# matrix has weak scale-free topology, so pickSoftThreshold only clears
# R^2 >= 0.85 at a power (24) where connectivity has already collapsed
# (max.k < 1) -> every gene falls into grey and module merging fails. Trust the
# estimate only when it is at/below this default; otherwise use the default.
default_power <- if (nrow(datExpr) < 20) 18 else if (nrow(datExpr) < 30) 16 else
                 if (nrow(datExpr) < 40) 14 else 12
power <- sft$powerEstimate
if (is.na(power) || power > default_power) power <- default_power
message(sprintf("chosen soft power: %d", power))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
r2 <- -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2]
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], r2, type = "n", xlab = "soft power",
     ylab = "scale-free R^2", main = "scale-free topology fit")
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], r2, labels = powers, col = "firebrick")
abline(h = 0.85, col = "grey60", lty = 2); abline(v = power, col = "steelblue", lty = 3)
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], sft$fitIndices[, 5], type = "n", xlab = "soft power",
     ylab = "mean connectivity", main = "mean connectivity")
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], sft$fitIndices[, 5], labels = powers, col = "firebrick")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ---- 6. robust signed WGCNA: bicor + signed network/TOM ----
net <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr, power = power,
  networkType = "signed", TOMType = "signed",
  corType = "bicor", maxPOutliers = 0.05,
  deepSplit = 2, minModuleSize = 30, mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, reassignThreshold = 0,
  numericLabels = TRUE, maxBlockSize = ncol(datExpr) + 1,
  nThreads = 16, saveTOMs = FALSE, verbose = 0)

module_colors <- labels2colors(net$colors)
names(module_colors) <- colnames(datExpr)
message(sprintf("modules found (excl. grey): %d",
                length(setdiff(unique(module_colors), "grey"))))
print(sort(table(module_colors), decreasing = TRUE))

plotDendroAndColors(net$dendrograms[[1]], module_colors[net$blockGenes[[1]]],
                    "module", dendroLabels = FALSE, hang = 0.03,
                    addGuide = TRUE, guideHang = 0.05,
                    main = "malignant-change co-expression modules")

# ---- 7. module eigengenes vs sample traits (module = malignant-change program) ----
samp_meta <- cd_p %>%
  dplyr::distinct(orig.merge, Tissue, Sample.Type.simple, Dx.simple)
subtype_df <- readRDS("results/subtype_df.rds")
samp_meta$subtype <- subtype_df$subtype[match(paste0(samp_meta$orig.merge, "__CTCL"),
                                              subtype_df$sample)]
rownames(samp_meta) <- samp_meta$orig.merge
samp_meta <- samp_meta[rownames(datExpr), ]

traits <- data.frame(
  skin        = as.integer(samp_meta$Tissue == "skin"),
  tumor_vs_pp = dplyr::case_when(samp_meta$Sample.Type.simple == "Tumor" ~ 1L,
                                 samp_meta$Sample.Type.simple == "Patch_Plaque" ~ 0L,
                                 TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
  subtype_S2  = dplyr::case_when(samp_meta$subtype == "Subtype_2" ~ 1L,
                                 samp_meta$subtype == "Subtype_1" ~ 0L,
                                 TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
  row.names   = rownames(datExpr))

MEs <- orderMEs(net$MEs)
me_lab <- paste0("ME", labels2colors(as.integer(sub("^ME", "", colnames(MEs)))))
colnames(MEs) <- me_lab

# binary traits -> Pearson (point-biserial); bicor is for continuous variables
mt_cor <- stats::cor(MEs, traits, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
mt_p   <- corPvalueStudent(mt_cor, nSamples = nrow(datExpr))

mt_df <- as.data.frame(mt_cor) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("module") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-module, names_to = "trait", values_to = "cor") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    as.data.frame(mt_p) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("module") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-module, names_to = "trait", values_to = "p"),
    by = c("module", "trait")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(module != "MEgrey") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(star = dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                        p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""),
                label = sprintf("%.2f%s", cor, star))

cor_lim <- max(abs(mt_df$cor), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(cor_lim)) cor_lim <- 1
p_mt <- ggplot(mt_df, aes(trait, module, fill = cor)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey90", high = "firebrick",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-cor_lim, cor_lim),
                       oob = scales::squish, name = "bicor") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "module eigengene vs trait") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p_mt)

# ---- 8. hub (top-kME) change-genes per module ----
kME <- signedKME(datExpr, MEs, corFnc = "bicor", corOptions = "maxPOutliers = 0.05")
hub_genes <- lapply(setdiff(colnames(MEs), "MEgrey"), function(me) {
  mod  <- sub("^ME", "", me)
  gset <- names(module_colors)[module_colors == mod]
  ord  <- gset[order(kME[gset, paste0("kME", mod)], decreasing = TRUE)]
  data.frame(module = mod, gene = head(ord, 12),
             kME = round(kME[head(ord, 12), paste0("kME", mod)], 3))
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
print(tibble::as_tibble(hub_genes), n = nrow(hub_genes))
```


<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Per-patient NMF -> recurrent malignant meta-programs         -->
<!-- ============================================================ -->
<!-- Alternative to the pseudobulk co-expression WGCNA above, designed to dodge -->
<!-- its failure modes. Programs are learned by NMF WITHIN each patient's        -->
<!-- malignant CD4 cells (so cohort/tissue batch can't drive them), then the     -->
<!-- per-patient programs are clustered by top-gene overlap into META-PROGRAMS   -->
<!-- that recur across patients (Gavish/Tirosh 2023). A meta-program = a         -->
<!-- coordinated malignant transcriptional program reproducibly deployed by many -->
<!-- independent patients. Fully self-contained: reads only the fig1 object      -->
<!-- (+ subtype_df for one trait). Chunk 1 builds the meta-programs; chunk 2      -->
<!-- scores cells and relates them to tissue/subtype/stage.                      -->

```{r malig_nmf_metaprograms}
library(RcppML)
library(UCell)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select, dplyr::filter, base::setdiff, .quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(42)

# ---- tunables ----
min_cells   <- 100     # min malignant cells for a patient to contribute programs
cap_cells   <- 2000    # per-patient cell cap (subsample larger samples)
n_hvg       <- 3000    # overdispersed genes fed to NMF
ranks       <- 4:9     # NMF factorization ranks per patient
top_n       <- 50      # top genes defining each program
min_overlap <- 10      # shared top genes (of 50) to link two programs
min_samples <- 5       # a meta-program must recur in >= this many patients

# ---- 1. malignant CD4 cells (same population as the pseudobulk analysis) ----
obj <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
mal <- subset(obj, subset = celltype == "T_Cells" & celltype.malig == "CTCL" &
                Tissue %in% c("blood", "skin") & !malig.pheno %in% c("GDT", "CD8"))

# keep patients with enough cells, then cap per-patient cell count
n_by_s   <- table(mal$orig.merge)
ok_samps <- names(n_by_s)[n_by_s >= min_cells]
cells_by_s <- split(colnames(mal), mal$orig.merge)[ok_samps]
keep_cells <- unlist(lapply(cells_by_s, function(cc)
  if (length(cc) > cap_cells) sample(cc, cap_cells) else cc), use.names = FALSE)
mal_ss <- subset(mal, cells = keep_cells)
mal_ss <- NormalizeData(mal_ss, verbose = FALSE)
message(sprintf("patients: %d | malignant cells used: %d", length(ok_samps), ncol(mal_ss)))

# ---- 2. overdispersed genes (drop TCR/BCR + mito technical drivers) ----
mal_ss  <- FindVariableFeatures(mal_ss, nfeatures = n_hvg, verbose = FALSE)
tcr_bcr <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJ]|^TR[AB]C|^IG[HKL][VDJ]|^IGH[ADEGM]|^IGKC|^IGLC",
                VariableFeatures(mal_ss), value = TRUE)
hvg  <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(mal_ss), c(tcr_bcr, grep("^MT-", VariableFeatures(mal_ss), value = TRUE)))
expr <- as(LayerData(mal_ss, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[hvg, ], "dgCMatrix")  # genes x cells
cell_sample <- as.character(mal_ss$orig.merge)
names(cell_sample) <- colnames(mal_ss)

# ---- 3. per-patient NMF; keep top-gene programs, de-duplicate across ranks ----
options(RcppML.threads = 1)          # single-thread NMF; parallelize across patients instead
run_patient_nmf <- function(s) {
  cols <- names(cell_sample)[cell_sample == s]
  A <- as.matrix(expr[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  A <- A - rowMeans(A)               # per-gene centering: keep positive deviations only
  A[A < 0] <- 0
  A <- A[rowSums(A) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(A) < top_n || ncol(A) < 30) return(NULL)
  progs <- list()
  for (r in ranks) {
    W <- RcppML::nmf(A, k = r, seed = 42, verbose = FALSE)$w
    rownames(W) <- rownames(A)
    for (f in seq_len(ncol(W)))
      progs[[length(progs) + 1]] <- names(sort(W[, f], decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(top_n)]
  }
  # within-patient de-dup: greedily drop near-identical programs across ranks
  keep <- logical(length(progs))
  for (i in seq_along(progs)) {
    dup <- FALSE
    for (j in which(keep))
      if (length(intersect(progs[[i]], progs[[j]])) >= 35) { dup <- TRUE; break }
    keep[i] <- !dup
  }
  progs[keep]
}

prog_lists <- parallel::mclapply(ok_samps, run_patient_nmf, mc.cores = 16)
names(prog_lists) <- ok_samps
prog_lists  <- prog_lists[!vapply(prog_lists, is.null, logical(1))]

programs    <- unlist(prog_lists, recursive = FALSE, use.names = FALSE)
prog_sample <- rep(names(prog_lists), lengths(prog_lists))
message(sprintf("robust per-patient programs: %d (from %d patients)",
                length(programs), length(prog_lists)))

# ---- 4. cluster programs into recurrent meta-programs (greedy founder) ----
build_metaprograms <- function(programs, prog_sample, min_overlap, min_samples, sig_size = top_n) {
  all_genes <- unique(unlist(programs))
  M  <- vapply(programs, function(g) as.integer(all_genes %in% g), integer(length(all_genes)))
  ov <- crossprod(M)                       # programs x programs: shared top genes
  active <- rep(TRUE, length(programs)); mps <- list()
  repeat {
    idx <- which(active); if (length(idx) < min_samples) break
    # founder = program reaching the most DISTINCT other patients at the overlap cutoff
    nb <- vapply(idx, function(i) {
      j <- idx[ov[i, idx] >= min_overlap & prog_sample[idx] != prog_sample[i]]
      length(unique(prog_sample[j]))
    }, integer(1))
    if (max(nb) + 1 < min_samples) break
    founder <- idx[which.max(nb)]
    cand <- idx[idx != founder & ov[founder, idx] >= min_overlap]
    members <- founder                     # one best-overlap program per contributing patient
    for (s in unique(prog_sample[cand])) {
      cs <- cand[prog_sample[cand] == s]
      members <- c(members, cs[which.max(ov[founder, cs])])
    }
    tab <- sort(table(unlist(programs[members])), decreasing = TRUE)  # recurrence-ranked signature
    mps[[length(mps) + 1]] <- list(
      genes      = names(tab)[seq_len(min(sig_size, length(tab)))],
      n_samples  = length(unique(prog_sample[members])),
      n_programs = length(members))
    active[members] <- FALSE
  }
  mps
}

mps <- build_metaprograms(programs, prog_sample, min_overlap, min_samples)
mp_sigs <- lapply(mps, `[[`, "genes")
names(mp_sigs) <- sprintf("MP%02d", seq_along(mp_sigs))

mp_summary <- data.frame(
  meta_program = names(mp_sigs),
  n_patients   = vapply(mps, `[[`, integer(1), "n_samples"),
  n_programs   = vapply(mps, `[[`, integer(1), "n_programs"),
  top_genes    = vapply(mp_sigs, function(g) paste(head(g, 12), collapse = ", "), character(1)))
message(sprintf("meta-programs recurring in >= %d patients: %d", min_samples, length(mp_sigs)))
print(tibble::as_tibble(mp_summary), n = nrow(mp_summary), width = Inf)
```

```{r malig_metaprogram_traits, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
# ---- 5. score every malignant cell for each meta-program (UCell, rank-based) ----
mal_ss <- AddModuleScore_UCell(mal_ss, features = mp_sigs, name = "", ncores = 16)

score_by_sample <- data.frame(
  orig.merge = mal_ss$orig.merge,
  mal_ss@meta.data[, names(mp_sigs), drop = FALSE]) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(orig.merge) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("orig.merge")

# ---- 6. per-sample traits (same encoding as the WGCNA module-trait map) ----
smeta <- mal_ss@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(orig.merge, Tissue, Sample.Type.simple)
subtype_df <- readRDS("results/subtype_df.rds")
smeta$subtype <- subtype_df$subtype[match(paste0(smeta$orig.merge, "__CTCL"), subtype_df$sample)]
rownames(smeta) <- smeta$orig.merge
smeta <- smeta[rownames(score_by_sample), ]

traits <- data.frame(
  skin        = as.integer(smeta$Tissue == "skin"),
  tumor_vs_pp = dplyr::case_when(smeta$Sample.Type.simple == "Tumor" ~ 1L,
                                 smeta$Sample.Type.simple == "Patch_Plaque" ~ 0L,
                                 TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
  subtype_S2  = dplyr::case_when(smeta$subtype == "Subtype_2" ~ 1L,
                                 smeta$subtype == "Subtype_1" ~ 0L,
                                 TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
  row.names   = rownames(score_by_sample))

mt_cor <- stats::cor(as.matrix(score_by_sample), as.matrix(traits), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
# two-sided p from the correlation t-statistic (n = sample count, approx over NA traits)
mt_p   <- 2 * pt(-abs(mt_cor * sqrt((nrow(traits) - 2) / (1 - mt_cor^2))), df = nrow(traits) - 2)

mt_df <- as.data.frame(mt_cor) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("meta_program") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-meta_program, names_to = "trait", values_to = "cor") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    as.data.frame(mt_p) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("meta_program") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-meta_program, names_to = "trait", values_to = "p"),
    by = c("meta_program", "trait")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(star = dplyr::case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                        p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""),
                label = sprintf("%.2f%s", cor, star))

cor_lim <- max(abs(mt_df$cor), na.rm = TRUE); if (!is.finite(cor_lim)) cor_lim <- 1
p_mp <- ggplot(mt_df, aes(trait, meta_program, fill = cor)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey90", high = "firebrick",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-cor_lim, cor_lim),
                       oob = scales::squish, name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "malignant meta-program vs trait") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p_mp)

# ---- 7. meta-program signatures (top recurrence-ranked genes) ----
mp_genes <- lapply(names(mp_sigs), function(m)
  data.frame(meta_program = m, rank = seq_len(min(15, length(mp_sigs[[m]]))),
             gene = head(mp_sigs[[m]], 15))) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
print(tibble::as_tibble(mp_genes), n = nrow(mp_genes))
```
